接下来的一段时间，日子又恢复了平常的节奏。每天上课，偶尔做几场手术，王建新的名字在医院里越来越响，来找他看病的人越来越多，但他该上课上课，该出操出操，该写思想汇报写思想汇报，一点没变。

每个星期天，如果有时间，他便请假回家一趟。每次从空间里挑一些东西带上，量不大，够吃几顿的。跟母亲说是军人服务社买的，改善改善家里人生活。

母亲接过东西，从嘴上说“又乱花钱”，到慢慢默认。这就是一个习惯过程。

王建新观察家里人吃着他带回的东西，身体状况调理得都很好。父亲的气色比刚回来那阵好了不少，脸上有肉了，眼角的皱纹也浅了。母亲的胃病不犯了，以前吃点凉的就不舒服，现在吃什么都行。大嫂的贫血也改善了，小妹丽丽脸上有了红晕，妞妞更是白白胖胖的，像个小瓷娃娃。一些隐性的小毛病、老毛病都在逐渐康复。空间里的东西带着灵气，吃久了，身体里的病气自然就被冲散了。

空间里的空地，王建新也利用晚上时间，陆陆续续全部种上了。那八十六种药材种子，人参、黄芪、当归、党参、枸杞、甘草、丹参、柴胡、白术、茯苓……一垄一垄的，整整齐齐。他按照种植要求，有的撒播，有的条播，有的点播，有的需要育苗移栽。种完了，浇上空间里的河水，没几天就出了苗，绿油油的，看着就喜人。

还剩下好多药材种子，看来能用好长时间。他把剩余种子用油纸包好，放进一个铁皮箱子里，密封起来，放在火车车厢的柜子里，阴凉干燥，不会发霉。

一九七〇年十二月下旬，北京寒风凛冽，气温骤降至零下。

街上的行人缩着脖子，哈出的气成了白雾。校园里的杨树光秃秃的，枝杈伸向灰蒙蒙的天空。北医的手术室里，却弥漫着焦灼又紧张的气息，跟外面的冷天完全是两个世界。

王建新这天正跟着老师学习。他的老师是张教授，神经外科的，五十多岁，头发花白，经验丰富。两人正在办公室里看片子，讨论一个病例，突然手术室那边打来电话，说有一台开颅手术遇到麻烦，请张教授过去看看。

“走，跟我去手术室。”张教授放下电话，站起来，穿上白大褂。

王建新跟着张教授，换好手术服，戴上帽子口罩，走进了手术室。

这是学校要求重点培养王建新所带来的好处。学校把他当重点培养对象，各科的老教授都愿意带他，有什么疑难杂症、复杂手术，都叫上他，让他观摩学习。

手术室里，气氛紧张得像拉满了的弓。

此时国内神经外科技术尚处于起步阶段，医疗设备简陋，缺乏精密的显微手术器械。脑部病变的定位与操作，全靠医生多年的临床经验和手感。没有CT，没有核磁，没有术中导航，全靠术前的几张X光片和医生的手去摸、去看、去判断。

这名患者是个四十多岁的男人，突发剧烈头痛、昏迷入院，经初步诊断为颅内深部病变。若不及时手术，随时会有生命危险。北医神经外科团队反复研讨手术方案，深知这场手术风险极大，凭自身团队实力难以稳妥把控，第一时间想到了在京城神经外科领域声名卓著的林教授，立刻发出紧急邀请，请他前来同台手术、协助攻坚。

林教授来了，五十出头，京城神经外科的“一把刀”。他亲自上台，亲自操刀，手术团队信心大增。

手术正式开始。林教授小心翼翼地打开患者颅腔，取下骨瓣，硬脑膜剪开，脑组织暴露出来。

可当颅骨被打开、脑组织暴露出来的那一刻，在场所有医生都倒吸一口凉气。

原本预判的病变位置、形态与实际情况相差甚远。患者颅内病变位置极深，且与脑部重要神经、血管紧密缠绕，结构复杂得超乎想象。病变组织像一团乱麻，跟正常的脑组织你中有我、我中有你，根本分不清哪是好的哪是坏的。每一处操作都可能触碰致命血管，引发大出血，或是损伤神经，导致患者终身残疾，甚至直接死亡。

In the following period, life returned to its normal rhythm.He goes to class every day and occasionally performs a few operations. Wang Jianxin's name is getting louder and louder in the hospital, and more and more people come to him for treatment. But he should go to class, do exercises, and write ideological reports. Nothing has changed.

Every Sunday, if he has time, he takes time off and goes home.Every time I pick something from the space and bring it with me. The quantity is not large, enough for several meals.I told my mother that I bought it from the Military Service Co., Ltd. to improve my family’s life.

The mother took the things and gradually said, "It's a waste of money again", but gradually acquiesced.This is a habitual process.

Wang Jianxin observed that his family members were eating the food he brought back, and their physical condition was in good condition.My father's complexion is much better than when he first came back. There is flesh on his face and the wrinkles at the corners of his eyes are lighter.My mother's stomach trouble is gone. She used to feel uncomfortable eating something cold, but now she can eat anything.The sister-in-law's anemia has also improved, the younger sister Lili has a blush on her face, and Niu Niu is white and fat, like a little porcelain doll.Some hidden ailments and old problems are gradually recovering.The things in the space are filled with spiritual energy. If you eat them for a long time, the disease energy in your body will naturally be dissipated.

Wang Jianxin also used his evening time to plant all the open spaces in the space one after another.The eighty-six kinds of medicinal seeds, including ginseng, astragalus, angelica, dangshen, wolfberry, licorice, salvia, bupleurum, atractylodes, poria... ridge after ridge, neatly arranged.According to the planting requirements, some broadcast sowing, some drill sowing, some on-demand sowing, and some require seedling transplanting.After planting, I poured water from the river in the space, and within a few days the seedlings appeared, green and gratifying to look at.

There are still a lot of medicinal seeds left, which look like they will last for a long time.He wrapped the remaining seeds in oil paper, put them in a tin box, sealed it, and placed it in a cabinet in a train carriage, where it was cool and dry and would not mold.

In late December 1970, Beijing was freezing and windy, with the temperature plummeting to below zero.

Pedestrians on the street shrank their necks, and their breath turned into white mist.The poplar trees on campus are bare, their branches stretching toward the gray sky.The operating room of Peking University Hospital was filled with anxious and nervous atmosphere, which was completely different from the cold weather outside.

Wang Jianxin is studying with the teacher that day.His teacher is Professor Zhang, a neurosurgeon in his fifties, with gray hair and rich experience.The two were watching movies and discussing a case in the office. Suddenly, there was a call from the operating room, saying that a craniotomy was in trouble and asked Professor Zhang to come over and take a look.

"Let's go to the operating room with me." Professor Zhang put down the phone, stood up, and put on his white coat.

Wang Jianxin followed Professor Zhang, changed into surgical clothes, put on a cap and mask, and walked into the operating room.

This is the benefit brought about by the school's requirement to focus on cultivating Wang Jianxin.The school regards him as a key training target, and senior professors in various subjects are willing to take him. If there are any difficult diseases or complex surgeries, they call him and let him observe and learn.

In the operating room, the atmosphere was as tense as a fully drawn bow.

At this time, domestic neurosurgery technology was still in its infancy, with rudimentary medical equipment and a lack of sophisticated microsurgical instruments.The localization and operation of brain lesions rely entirely on the doctor’s years of clinical experience and touch.There is no CT, no MRI, and no intraoperative navigation. It depends entirely on a few preoperative X-rays and the doctor's hands to touch, see, and judge.

The patient was a man in his forties who was hospitalized due to a sudden severe headache and coma. He was initially diagnosed with deep intracranial lesions.If surgery is not performed in time, life may be in danger at any time.Peking University's neurosurgery team repeatedly discussed the surgical plan and knew that this operation was extremely risky and could not be safely controlled by their own team strength. They immediately thought of Professor Lin, who is well-known in the field of neurosurgery in Beijing, and immediately sent an urgent invitation to come and perform the same surgery to assist in the critical task.

Here comes Professor Lin, who is in his early fifties and is the “sword” of neurosurgery in Beijing.He personally went on stage and performed the surgery himself, which greatly increased the confidence of the surgical team.

The operation officially begins.Professor Lin carefully opened the patient's cranial cavity, removed the bone flap, cut the dura mater, and exposed the brain tissue.

But when the skull was opened and the brain tissue was exposed, all the doctors present took a breath.

The originally predicted location and shape of the lesion were far from the actual situation.The patient's intracranial lesions are extremely deep and closely intertwined with important nerves and blood vessels in the brain. The structure is unimaginably complex.The diseased tissue is like a mess, different from the normal brain tissue, and it is impossible to tell which is good and which is bad.Every operation may touch fatal blood vessels, cause massive bleeding, or damage nerves, leading to lifelong disability or even death.
